what: Run log of the prediction sweep: the launcher's record of every parallel reader — what it was given, when, by whom, under which protocol — kept apart from the readers' own self-reported provenance in each batch file, so each can be checked against the other.

launcher.role: TACHYON — Claude, Anthropic; in-session coordinator under MANUS (Lee Sharks) direction

ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-10-15: "shape g. parallel reading, but they need to keep track of what theyve read and havent and how. the agents need to track their own provenance as well"

pilot_finding: Calibration (CAL, blind re-read of the eight in-session readings): every substantive item found; four boundary disagreements of shape (stage text vs embedded forecast; a third-party timestamp left inside a forecast quote; a benchmark folded into its prediction; a monitoring check read as F). The reader found more than the in-session reading (G claims in #914 and #1182) and recorded one forecast several times across stage, table and ledger. Protocol revised to v1.1 with seven boundary rules.
